Directions: Read and study the sources about the iron and steel industry. Then use the three sources and your knowledge of social studies to answer each question that follows.
Context: Inventor William Kelly `(text(1811)-text(1888))` developed a process that made steel stronger and cheaper. Steel became the most important construction material of the Industrial Revolution.
Title: Source 1: Adapted from William Kelly
Author: by Arshad Mahmud
Content: Kelly succeeded in producing iron and steel with his newly developed process. The quality of the steel was still largely uncertain. He did not patent¹ the process immediately, but continued working on it.

In `text(1856)`, Henry Bessemer patented a similar process and was applying for a patent in the United States. Bessemer was trying to make stronger steel and had proved his method a success. In `text(1857)`, Kelly was also granted a patent for his process.
